MediaPipe Face Mesh
===================

This directory contains the browser distribution of
`@mediapipe/face_mesh` version `0.4.1633559619`.

Source: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/face_mesh
License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE` in this directory)

The files are vendored so face landmark detection runs on-device and remains
available to the installed PWA after the application shell has been cached.
